pick.headline: Saudi King Khalid dies; Fahd succeeds

evidence.title: FBIS DAILY REPORT: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 114, 14 June 1982
evidence.snippet: Death of Saudi King Announcement of Khalid Death, Fahd Appointment -- On 13 June a royal court statement broadcast by SPA announced the death of King Khalid ibn ‘Abd al-'Aziz following a heart attack. SPA subsequently announced that Crown Prince Fahd ibn ‘Abd al…
